resolution: Round 1 of the concept-art matching loop for the section C content browser. Rebuilt LibraryPanel as the asset dock: tucked 350px state matches concept 4 (Assets header with expand toggle, boxed search with magnifier, Favorites/Recent quick rows wired to the existing materials-favorites/materials-recent pseudo-folders, taller rounded tree rows with solid-accent selected fill, count footer, and the selected-material detail card with thumbnail, meta, variant chips, and the focus verb). The expand toggle widens the region to a second fixed constant (680) and attaches concept 1's grid column right of the tree: breadcrumb trail from the live content tree, pager, and flexing material/model/asset grids with bigger page sizes. Tucked-mode model tree rows open the model document directly since the gallery is tucked away. libraryExpanded persists across hot reloads via the view hotstate atom. Docs updated (editor_sections.md + regions.ts SECTIONS.C). Bundle-verified; awaiting the user's next screenshot round.
